command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote
root=Path.cwd()
md=['Product Decisions.md','Architecture.md','Implementation Plan.md','Repository Structure.md','README.md','specs/README.md','specs/datasets.md']
drafts=[f'specs/changes/{sid}/spec.json' for sid in ['HG-0003','HG-0004','HG-0005','HG-0006','HG-0007','HG-0008','HG-0010']]
json_paths=drafts+['specs/catalog.json','specs/changes/HG-0011/spec.json','.highgrade/project/documents.json','.highgrade/project/survey.json','specs/changes/HG-0011/evidence/before.json','specs/changes/HG-0011/evidence/checks-v1.json']
checks=[]
def check(name,ok,details):
    checks.append({'name':name,'outcome':'passed' if ok else 'failed','details':details})
for f in json_paths:
    try: json.loads(Path(f).read_text());check('JSON '+f,True,'Parsed with Python json; contract structure is checked separately by spec-validate.')
    except Exception as e: check('JSON '+f,False,str(e))
old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:Product Decisions.md'],text=True)
new=Path(md[0]).read_text()
ids=lambda s:re.findall(r'^### (PD-\d+)\.',s,re.M)
check('Decision IDs',ids(new)==ids(old)+['PD-39','PD-40'],'Retain the exact original decision order and append only PD-39/40.')
section=lambda s,a,b:s.split('### '+a+'.',1)[1].split('### '+b+'.',1)[0]
check('PD-08 meaning preserved',section(old,'PD-08','PD-09')==section(new,'PD-08','PD-09'),'Existing subskill definitions and zero-denominator/valid-alternative safeguards are byte-identical.')
rate=next(l for l in old.splitlines() if l.startswith('**Delegated decision.** Use up to the latest four'))
check('Recent rate policy preserved',rate in new,'The complete recent four-per-stream/90-day/rate/trend paragraph is retained verbatim.')
privacy=next(l for l in old.splitlines() if l.startswith('**Delegated decision.** Require authenticated tutor access'))
check('Existing privacy policy preserved',privacy in new,'The original permission/retention/deletion policy is retained verbatim; new history inherits it.')
origins=lambda s:re.findall(r'^- \*\*[AI]:.*$',s,re.M)
check('Original provenance preserved',origins(old)==origins(new),'A/I original source links are unchanged; their external contents were not read.')
for f in drafts:
    a=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+f],text=True));b=json.loads(Path(f).read_text())
    old_s={s['id'] for o in a['operations'] for s in o['requirement']['scenarios']}
    new_s={s['id'] for o in b['operations'] for s in o['requirement']['scenarios']}
    check('Draft scope '+b['id'],not b['archived'] and not any(t['done'] for t in b['tasks']) and old_s<=new_s and b['created_at']==a['created_at'],'Existing scenario IDs/creation identity retained; application tasks remain unimplemented and unintegrated.')
links=[];external=[];errors=[]
def anchors(text):
    out=set();counts={}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m=re.match(r'^#{1,6}\s+(.+?)\s*#*$',line)
        if not m:continue
        base=re.sub(r'[^\w\s-]','',m.group(1).lower()).strip().replace(' ','-')
        n=counts.get(base,0);counts[base]=n+1;out.add(base+(('-'+str(n)) if n else ''))
    return out
for f in md:
    text=Path(f).read_text()
    for m in re.finditer(r'\[[^\]\n]*\]\((?:<([^>\n]+)>|([^\)\n]+))\)',text):
        target=m.group(1) or m.group(2)
        if re.match(r'^(https?://|mailto:)',target):continue
        path,sep,anchor=target.partition('#')
        p=(Path(f).parent/unquote(path)).resolve() if path else Path(f).resolve()
        if not p.is_relative_to(root):external.append({'from':f,'target':target,'status':'unchanged historical external provenance; content not inspected'});continue
        err=None
        if not p.exists():err='missing target'
        elif sep and p.suffix=='.md' and unquote(anchor) not in anchors(p.read_text()):err='missing standard heading anchor'
        item={'from':f,'target':target,'outcome':'failed' if err else 'passed'}
        if err:item['reason']=err;errors.append(item)
        links.append(item)
check('Local document links/anchors',not errors,{'checked':len(links),'errors':errors,'external_provenance_excluded':external})
allowed=set(md+drafts+['specs/catalog.json'])
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines()
check('Tracked change scope',set(changed)<=allowed,{'changed':changed,'unexpected':sorted(set(changed)-allowed)})
report={'check_type':'Document JSON/link/preservation checks','captured_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'baseline_git_revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'checks':checks,'links':links,'inputs':{f:hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in md+drafts},'limits':'Static JSON parsing, standard local Markdown links/anchors and explicit preservation checks only. No network, application tests, authored gold fixtures, listening playback, learner data or pedagogical-effectiveness verification.'}
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
sys.exit(any(c['outcome']=='failed' for c in checks))
